mainText: Hello, Verona! At 1 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we have clear skies at Verona Community Park with a temperature of 77 degrees, and please be aware of an elevated air quality index of 52.

The City of Verona is reminding residents to inspect their mailboxes to ensure they meet USPS specifications to prevent damage during snow plowing season, and students are invited to submit designs for a new local I Voted sticker contest by July 22.

We have a busy schedule starting today with Yoga at Insight Wellness, the Concerts in the Park series, and trivia at Hop Haus. Tomorrow, catch live music at Bailey's Run and Wisconsin Brewing Company.
In our weekly police report, on July 13, a 36-year-old man was arrested for his first O-W-I offense after his vehicle became stuck on a large rock.
Treat yourself to today's flavor, Really Reese's, available at Culver's until they close tonight at 10 PM.
